subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat retain an accessible manual catch-up affordance while offering a browser-local mode that hides or reduces the “New messages” indicator?
rationale: The adjacent merged work intentionally preserves this control even when auto-scroll is off, so choosing suppression semantics and an accessibility fallback is product design rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Browser-local indicator mode
options.body: Add a persisted UI setting that keeps the manual catch-up action available through an accessible alternative while allowing a less intrusive presentation.

options.title: Keep the current affordance
options.body: Retain the existing indicator and treat `chatAutoScroll` modes as the supported reading-flow customization.

options.title: Gateway-managed policy
options.body: Add a documented gateway setting only if administrators need to impose the same indicator behavior for all WebChat users.

recommendation.title: Browser-local indicator mode
recommendation.body: Add a persisted UI setting that keeps the manual catch-up action available through an accessible alternative while allowing a less intrusive presentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current-main WebChat scroll/render/settings history and prior issue review point to this area as the most direct routing path.
